ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in recent Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota
questions: How did the defendants obtain the fraudulent funds?
What were the funds used for?
ideas.insight: This story idea is significant because it could reveal patterns and connections between entities involved in Medicaid fraud. By following the money, we may be able to identify key players and uncover a larger scheme.
